author_or_institution: U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission and U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission staffs
title: Findings Regarding the Market Events of May 6, 2010
book_use: Documented sequence of the May 6 Flash Crash: stressed liquidity, the 75,000-contract automated E-mini sell program, volume-sensitive execution, high-frequency trading and hot-potato dynamics, cross-market coupling, collapsing market depth, and the role of pauses and market-structure controls.
